mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; irbesartan may have minor CYP3A4 inhibitory effects, and both drugs have anticholinergic properties that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, dizziness); consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if adverse effects emerge; counsel on adequate hydration.
